title: Sendspin BT Bridge Configuration
description: Machine-readable schema for /config/config.json used by the Sendspin BT Bridge.

CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION.description: Schema version; managed by the application — do not change.

SENDSPIN_SERVER.description: Music Assistant server hostname/IP. 'auto' uses mDNS discovery.

SENDSPIN_PAIRING.description: Require Music Assistant to pair with a PIN before playback. Off by default so speakers play as soon as Music Assistant finds them. Transport encryption still runs; this only gates pairing.

SENDSPIN_OWN_SERVER_ONLY.description: Accept only this bridge's own Music Assistant. When another Music Assistant on the network dials a speaker first, the bridge turns it away so the speaker stays available to the right one. Has no effect until the bridge knows its Music Assistant (a server address or the Music Assistant API URL).

WEB_PORT.description: Web UI port. null = use WEB_PORT env var or 8080.

BASE_LISTEN_PORT.description: Override per-device Sendspin listener base port. null = auto-assign.

BRIDGE_NAME.description: Bridge instance name. Empty or 'auto' resolves to hostname.

players.description: Configured players (schema v6). Each has an id, a name and a backend (bluetooth_a2dp or pulse_sink).

PLAYER_STATE.description: Runtime state keyed by player id: volume (0-100), sink, released, released_by.

HA_AREA_NAME_ASSIST_ENABLED.description: Enable automatic room name assist from Home Assistant areas.

HA_ADAPTER_AREA_MAP.description: Manual mapping of adapter MAC → Home Assistant area.

PREFER_SBC_CODEC.description: Prefer SBC codec over AAC/aptX for Bluetooth audio.

BT_CHECK_INTERVAL.description: Bluetooth connection check interval in seconds.

BT_MAX_RECONNECT_FAILS.description: Max consecutive reconnect failures before giving up. 0 = unlimited.

BT_CHURN_THRESHOLD.description: Number of rapid connect/disconnect cycles triggering churn isolation. 0 = disabled.

BT_CHURN_WINDOW.description: Window in seconds for churn threshold counting.

BRUTE_FORCE_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Max failed login attempts before lockout.

BRUTE_FORCE_WINDOW_MINUTES.description: Time window for counting failed login attempts.

BRUTE_FORCE_LOCKOUT_MINUTES.description: Lockout duration after exceeding max attempts.

STARTUP_BANNER_GRACE_SECONDS.description: Grace period before showing startup guidance banners.

RECOVERY_BANNER_GRACE_SECONDS.description: Grace period before showing recovery guidance banners.

AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH.description: PBKDF2-SHA256 password hash. Managed by the application — do not edit manually.

SECRET_KEY.description: Flask session secret key. Auto-generated on first startup — do not edit.

MA_TOKEN_INSTANCE_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname of the MA instance the token was issued for.

MA_TOKEN_LABEL.description: Label for the MA API token.

MA_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: MA OAuth access token. Managed by the application.

MA_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: MA OAuth refresh token. Managed by the application.

MA_ADDON_SLUG.description: HA add-on mode: slug of a Music Assistant add-on from a custom repository the bridge may sign in through (official and local add-ons need no entry).

MA_WEBSOCKET_MONITOR.description: Enable persistent WebSocket connection to MA for real-time updates.

VOLUME_VIA_MA.description: Route volume commands through Music Assistant API.

MUTE_VIA_MA.description: Route mute commands through Music Assistant API.

SMOOTH_RESTART.description: Enable smooth daemon restart (reconnect IPC instead of full restart).

DISABLE_PA_RESCUE_STREAMS.description: Disable PulseAudio module-rescue-streams correction on BT reconnect.

PULSE_SINK_RESET_ON_START.description: Suspend and resume each local audio output once before its player first starts, to wake an output that came up stuck.

DUPLICATE_DEVICE_CHECK.description: Check MA API for duplicate device registrations across bridges.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Additional trusted proxy IP addresses for X-Forwarded-For.

EXPERIMENTAL_A2DP_SINK_RECOVERY_DANCE.description: Experimental: last-resort A2DP sink recovery via disconnect→reconnect when sink is missing after connect. Workaround for bluez/bluez#1922. May cause extra churn on some devices.

EXPERIMENTAL_PA_MODULE_RELOAD.description: Experimental: reload PulseAudio module-bluez5-discover as a last resort when bluez_card.* fails to appear. Disrupts all active BT audio on the bridge.

EXPERIMENTAL_ADAPTER_AUTO_RECOVERY.description: Experimental: after BT_MAX_RECONNECT_FAILS consecutive failed reconnects, power-cycle the adapter through Bluetooth MGMT/HCI and optionally issue a USB reset if the power cycle fails. Disruptive to every device on that controller. Requires Linux Bluetooth capabilities; USB escalation additionally requires /dev/bus/usb access.

COMPENSATE_OUTPUT_LATENCY.description: Take the PulseAudio buffer's latency out of the playback schedule, so audio leaves the audio server at its scheduled time whatever PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC is. Off restores the timing before 3.1.0-beta.7, where speakers played behind by that latency. The SENDSPIN_COMPENSATE_OUTPUT_LATENCY environment variable overrides it.

PLAYOUT_DIAG.description: Playback clock diagnostics: let the audio sink provide its own clock so the log's Clock diag line also reports the sink's audio clock rate. Playback timing is unchanged. The SENDSPIN_PLAYOUT_DIAG environment variable overrides it.

RSSI_BADGE.description: Poll live RSSI for connected BR/EDR speakers via the kernel mgmt socket (opcode 0x0031) every 5 s and surface it in the device card / scan results as a coloured signal-strength chip. BR/EDR returns delta from the controller's Golden Receive Power Range (0 = good, negative = weak), LE returns absolute dBm. Adds one mgmt round-trip per connected device per tick, gated by the shared bt_operation_lock. Legacy key ``EXPERIMENTAL_RSSI_BADGE`` is migrated automatically.

HA_INTEGRATION.description: Home Assistant integration: MQTT discovery (transport B) and/or mDNS-advertised REST surface for the custom_component (transport A1). Bridge-only entities — never duplicates Music Assistant's media_player.<name>.

mode.description: Transport selector — pick exactly one. ``both`` was removed in v2.65.0-rc.3 because it caused duplicate HA entities; legacy stored values are normalised to ``mqtt`` on load.

broker.description: Broker host or 'auto' (Supervisor MQTT add-on auto-detect).

client_id.description: Optional MQTT client_id; empty = auto-derived from bridge_id.

advertise_mdns.description: Publish _sendspin-bridge._tcp.local. so HA's Zeroconf discovery offers our integration.

supervisor_pair.description: On HAOS, allow the custom_component to obtain a long-lived bearer token via the SUPERVISOR_TOKEN round-trip pairing endpoint.

advertise_host.description: Address announced to Home Assistant instead of the detected one (reverse proxy, NAT). Empty = detect.

advertise_port.description: Port announced to Home Assistant instead of the web port. 0 = the web port.

SYNC_PROFILES.description: Named per-group delay profiles for Music Assistant sync groups (managed by the Sync screen, not the settings form).

AUTH_TOKENS.description: Long-lived API bearer tokens used by the HA custom_component. Plaintext tokens are returned only at issuance — the persisted form stores PBKDF2-SHA256 hashes.

id.description: Stable player id. A Bluetooth player's id is uuid5 of its MAC unless a file says otherwise; never changes.

listen_port.description: Override Sendspin listener port for this device.

static_delay_ms.description: Per-device static audio delay in milliseconds (0–5000). Added on top of DAC-anchored sync.

static_delay_source.description: Provenance of the per-device static delay. auto_pending is an internal one-shot initialization marker.

static_delay_calibrated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last confirmed calibration.

static_delay_codec.description: Codec active when the delay was calibrated.

required_lead_time_ms.description: Sendspin startup lead time advertised by this device.

min_buffer_ms.description: Sendspin minimum ongoing buffer advertised by this device.

idle_mode.description: Per-device idle behavior: 'default' (no action), 'power_save' (suspend PA sink to release A2DP), 'auto_disconnect' (full BT disconnect after timeout), 'keep_alive' (periodic infrasound bursts).

power_save_delay_minutes.description: Minutes after sink idle before suspending PA sink in power_save mode.

idle_disconnect_minutes.description: Minutes of idle before BT standby disconnect. 0 = disabled. Legacy field — prefer idle_mode.

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive infrasound bursts; 0 turns them off.

keep_alive_method.description: Payload for keepalive bursts: 'infrasound' (default — 2 Hz subsonic stereo), 'silence' (zero PCM, same length, for speakers that misbehave on the 2 Hz tone), 'none' (skip — let speaker time out naturally).

room_id.description: Home Assistant area/room ID for this device.

backend.description: What the player plays to: a Bluetooth A2DP speaker or a local PulseAudio/PipeWire sink. The type of an existing player cannot change.

Player.description: One player: a speaker the bridge keeps connected and fed with a Sendspin stream.

match.description: Server-owned hardware identity of the sink; ignored when sent by a client.

device_class.description: Override the local Bluetooth Class of Device for this adapter (six-hex form, e.g. '0x00010c' for Computer/Laptop). Empty string leaves the kernel/bluetoothd default in place. Some peers — notably Samsung Q-series soundbars (bluez/bluez#1025) — reject incoming BR/EDR connections whose initiator CoD they don't recognise; setting this to '0x00010c' is the documented workaround.
